title: EverythingIsTotem
description: Cheat the death with your inventory
body:
# EverythingIsTotem
Required Plugin: https://modrinth.com/plugin/kotlinplugins
- Turns all the items in your inventory into Totems of Undying.
- It doesn't count weapons, armor, tools as Totems.
- You have to own unique items, similar ones ( stacks etc. ) can't be taken advantage of. 
- The purpose of this plugin is to improve pvp experience, follow popular trends from tiktok, youtube but also to prevent the potential death.
- Check out other plugins: https://modrinth.com/user/Winlyps
